فعال‌سازی شیمیایی کاتد ناشی از الکترولیت با آب جزئی و گونه‌های Mg/Cl، برگشت‌پذیری کاتدهای اکسیدی و آلی باتری منیزیم را بهبود می‌دهد و واسط Sn/MgCl2 آند را محافظت می‌کند.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in shifting from host-centric cathode design to electrolyte-derived chemical activation, using trace water to generate Mg/Cl species that activate cathodes and stabilize anion redox. Significance: this enables reversible electrochemistry across oxide, organic, and conversion cathodes, with a Sn/MgCl2 interface preventing anode passivation—establishing a general principle for regulating cathode reaction pathways in high-energy magnesium batteries.
🏷 magnesium battery · cathode activation · electrolyte chemistry · MnO2 cathode · artificial interface

item.title: Manipulating Li2MnO3-Like Domain Dispersion in Lithium-Rich Layered Oxides Inherited from Precursor
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in establishing that precursor transition-metal separation templates Li2MnO3-like domain dispersion in lithium-rich cathodes—clustered precursors yield localized ordering, less-ordered precursors yield dispersed ordering. This synthesis–structure relationship was previously underexplored. Its significance: precursor design enables structural regulation, and more dispersed domains improve electrochemical stability with mitigated voltage decay, offering a practical route to high-performance cathodes.

item.title: Rational Integration of Multiple Additives for High-Temperature Lithium-Ion Batteries
item.description:
برهم‌کنش مضر SN و LiBOB شناسایی و با جایگزینی TPAB، شیمی افزودنی FEC-LiBOB-TPAB برای باتری لیتیوم-یونی دما بالا با حفظ ظرفیت ۶۸.۷٪ پس از ۳۰۰ چرخه ارائه شد.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in identifying a detrimental SN–LiBOB interaction on Gr-Si anodes, where LiBOB-derived electron-deficient boron SEI promotes SN reduction and disrupts FEC-driven SEI formation. Replacing SN with TPAB avoids this while suppressing transition metal dissolution. This enables thermally stable interphases and 68.7% capacity retention after 300 cycles at 45 °C, highlighting rational multi-additive design for high-temperature LIBs.
🏷 electrolyte additives · lithium-ion battery · graphite-silicon anode · solid electrolyte interphase · high-temperature cycling

item.title: Jahn–Teller Distortion Triggers Unconventional Molecular O 2 Formation in P2‐Type Na 0.67 MnO 2 Cathodes
item.description:
در کاتد P2-Na0.67MnO2، اعوجاج یاهن-تلر حین دشارژ باعث تشکیل برگشت‌ناپذیر O2 مولکولی می‌شود و هم‌دوپینگ Al/Si با سرکوب این اعوجاج پایداری چرخه را بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in identifying Jahn–Teller distortion during discharge—not high-voltage charging—as the trigger for molecular O₂ formation in P2-type Na₀.₆₇MnO₂ cathodes. This reveals a previously unrecognized distortion-mediated oxygen redox pathway. Al/Si co-doping suppresses this distortion, stabilizing O 2p states and inhibiting O–O dimerization, yielding 95% capacity retention after 100 cycles, offering a practical design strategy for stable sodium-ion batteries.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · oxygen redox · Jahn-Teller distortion · molecular O2 · Al/Si co-doping

item.title: Dynamic Thermal Regulation of Li‐Mg Batteries via Microencapsulated Phase Change Materials Embedded in High‐Entropy MOF Matrices

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in hollow high-entropy MOF microcapsules with oxygen vacancies and hierarchical porosity, encapsulating flame-retardant TEP gated by phase-change material for smart thermal-triggered release. This integrates dendrite suppression, fast ion transport, and thermal-runaway prevention in one gel electrolyte, enabling 80.5 mAh g⁻¹ at 80 C and only 1.55% degradation over 20,000 cycles—advancing intrinsically safe, high-energy Li-Mg batteries.
